title: The Panoramic Crop Is a Decision, Not a Format
excerpt: A wide frame changes how the eye moves through a photograph, and it only works when the scene's breadth is the point. Photographer Kate Garibaldi explains when to crop, when to stitch, and when to leave the frame alone.

title: Two Ways to Beat Bright Sun With a Flash
excerpt: Shoot a flash portrait at f/1.2 in midday sun and most cameras hit a wall: the sync speed. Photographer Miguel Quiles tests the two ways past it, high-speed sync and the Sony a9 III's global shutter, and the power difference is the whole lesson.

title: The Sigma FP2 Is a Camera You Finish Yourself
excerpt: The Sigma FP2 ships without a viewfinder, a grip, a hotshoe, or image stabilisation, and that is the point. DPReview explains who a modular full-frame camera is actually for, and why it only makes sense if your needs were never on a big manufacturer's list.
